description: This Java class defines a 'ConnectionDeletedStrategy' which implements event handling logic for 'ConnectionDeleted' events in a messaging persistence context. It modifies the connection's lifecycle state to 'DELETED' when such an event occurs.

classes.name: ConnectionDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles 'ConnectionDeleted' events by updating the connection's lifecycle status to 'DELETED'.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a 'ConnectionDeleted' event; if the connection exists, updates its lifecycle to 'DELETED', otherwise returns null.
